# Kevin behavioral-cognitive analysis release receipt — 2026-09-04

Materialized public source commit: `82e8ccab9354ac6b46165bcfcdb5e135a247aaee`.

This release adds an evidence-bounded behavioral-cognitive analysis layer to Kevin Research Studio. The layer analyzes observable research behavior such as uncertainty handling, failure response, scope control, formalization, verification behavior, attribution, feedback integration, breadth/depth tension and autonomy growth.

Boundary: public or permissioned evidence only; no clinical diagnosis, no inference of private health, trauma, hidden motives or unobserved emotional states.

The layer requires a four-stage inference chain: observation → repeated behavioral pattern → explicitly labeled cognitive-strategy hypothesis → consent-respecting development proposal. Kevin retains Right of Reply and can falsify or correct the behavioral model with stronger evidence.

Independent benchmark targets include behavioral-claim precision, unsupported-trait rate, chronology sensitivity, counterexample retention, subject-feedback correction and separation of observable behavior from hidden mental state.
